name: jobtofill
description: Browser extension that autofills job applications and everyday forms.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:firefox: BROWSER=firefox node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/fill.test.mjs tests/e2e/pages.test.mjs tests/e2e/letter.test.mjs tests/e2e/upload.test.mjs tests/e2e/answers.test.mjs tests/e2e/education.test.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check.mjs && npm run build --silent && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
